summary: The diff implements Object.values as the spec describes. It calls ops::to_object on args[0] with `?`, then ops::enumerable_own_properties with the Value kind with `?`, then wraps ops::create_array_from_list in Value::Object. The order matches steps 1–3. The step comments stay above their code. Errors propagate with `?`, nothing is hardcoded, and there is no special-casing or unrelated edits. The renamed unused parameters (_this, _new_target) and the removed placeholder `let _ = ...` are fine. I only saw this one file, so I could not confirm the signatures of the ops helpers or the get_or_undefined extension. The gate report (40 test262 runs, +32 passing, 0 regressions) fits a change this size.
